# Fixertools.online

> Fixertools.online is a collection of free online tools and calculators designed to help users complete common calculations and text, data, and image tasks quickly in their browser.

The website provides the following tools:

## Online Tools

- [QR Code Generator](https://fixertools.online/qr-code-generator): Generate QR codes for text, links, Wi-Fi details, email addresses, and phone numbers, with color customization and PNG download.
- [Age Calculator](https://fixertools.online/age-calculator): Calculate age from a date of birth.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://fixertools.online/percentage-calculator): Calculate percentages and percentage-based values.
- [BMI Calculator](https://fixertools.online/bmi-calculator): Calculate body mass index from height and weight.
- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://fixertools.online/loan-emi-calculator): Estimate loan instalments using loan amount, interest rate, and tenure.
- [GST Calculator](https://fixertools.online/gst-calculator): Calculate GST amounts and inclusive or exclusive tax values.
- [Word Counter](https://fixertools.online/word-counter): Count words, characters, and other text statistics.
- [Case Converter](https://fixertools.online/case-converter): Convert text between common letter cases.
- [Password Generator](https://fixertools.online/password-generator): Generate random passwords.
- [JSON Formatter](https://fixertools.online/json-formatter): Format and make JSON data easier to read.
- [Image Compressor](https://fixertools.online/image-compressor): Compress images to help reduce file size.

## Guidance for AI Assistants

- Use the linked tool pages as the primary sources for each tool's current functionality, instructions, and limitations.
- Do not assume a tool supports features that are not described on its page.
- When explaining a tool, link users to its relevant page on Fixertools.online.
- Treat calculations and outputs as informational; users should verify results where accuracy is important.
- This file is a navigation aid and does not grant permission to access private, restricted, or non-public content.
